action.objective: Evade the check with Kf2, keeping the king off the g-file and away from Black's bishop on h5.
action.rationale: Both legal evasions are commit-ready and unavoidable_mate=true, so accept_risk is not applicable. Kf2 is the strongest candidate: deepest shared comparison favors it (exact -365 vs Kg1's deeper -598), it avoids the g1 square where Black's bishop yields a mating net (Kg1 ... Qe3 ... Be2#), and it keeps options to contest the d4/e5 pawns. Verification safety.complete covers immediate mates only; tactical probes show both king moves are refuted by a forced mate-in-2 pattern, so no move is truly safe — Kf2 is the least bad by depth and score.
